school.tagged_body:
Volunteers Wanted: Happy Tails Animal Shelter

Do you love animals? Do you want to help your community? Happy Tails Animal Shelter {{g:is looking for|현재진행형: be동사 + -ing (~을 찾고 있다)}} student {{v:volunteers}}!

Our {{v:shelter}} {{v:takes care of}} about 60 dogs and 25 cats. Their {{v:owners}} left them, or they {{v:got lost}}. We need your help. Please {{t:give them a better life}} {{g:before they meet|before + 주어 + 동사: ~하기 전에 (시간 접속사)}} their new families.

Volunteer Activities
- Walk dogs
- Clean {{v:cages}} and feeding bowls
- Play with cats
- Take photos of animals for our {{v:adoption}} website

Requirements
- {{g:You must be|must + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 (의무)}} 14 years old or older.
- Students under 16 must come with a parent or {{v:guardian}}.
- Volunteers must take a one-hour {{v:training}} class first.

Schedule
- Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.
- Please come {{g:two times a month|횟수 + a + 기간: ~에 …번}} or more.

You will get a volunteer hours {{v:certificate}}. (3 hours for each visit)

{{g:To apply|to부정사 부사적 용법(목적): ~하기 위해}}, {{v:fill out}} the online form on our website by October 31. {{g:If you have any questions|조건의 if: 만약 ~라면}}, please call 053-987-6543.

Note: Please wear {{v:comfortable}} clothes. Your clothes {{g:may get dirty|may + 동사원형: ~일지도 모른다 / get + 형용사: ~하게 되다}}!

questions.q: What is the purpose of this notice?
choices: To find student volunteers for an animal shelter
To invite people to a pet show
To teach students how to take photos
questions.answer: To find student volunteers for an animal shelter

questions.q: How many animals does the shelter take care of?
questions.explanation: 개 약 60마리 + 고양이 약 25마리 = 약 85마리.

questions.q: Which is NOT a volunteer activity?
questions.explanation: 개 산책, 우리·밥그릇 청소, 고양이와 놀기, 사진 찍기만 나온다. 개 목욕은 없다.

questions.q: Why do volunteers take photos of the animals?
questions.explanation: 'Take photos of animals for our adoption website.' 입양 웹사이트에 올리기 위해서이다.

questions.q: How old must you be to volunteer?
questions.explanation: 'You must be 14 years old or older.'

questions.q: Mina is 15 years old. What does she need to do to volunteer?
choices: Come with a parent or guardian
questions.answer: Come with a parent or guardian
questions.explanation: 16세 미만 학생은 부모님이나 보호자와 함께 와야 한다. 15세는 14세 이상이라 봉사는 가능하다.

questions.q: What must volunteers do first?
questions.explanation: 'Volunteers must take a one-hour training class first.'

questions.q: When can volunteers work at the shelter?
questions.explanation: 'Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.'

questions.q: How long do volunteers work on each visit?
questions.explanation: 오전 10시부터 오후 1시까지이므로 3시간이다. 확인서에도 방문 1회당 3시간이 적힌다.

questions.q: How often should volunteers come?
choices: Two times a month or more
questions.answer: Two times a month or more
questions.explanation: 'Please come two times a month or more.'

questions.q: What will volunteers get?
questions.explanation: 'You will get a volunteer hours certificate.'

questions.q: Junho visits the shelter four times. How many volunteer hours does he get?
questions.explanation: 방문 1회당 3시간이므로 3 × 4 = 12시간이다.

questions.q: How can students apply?
choices: By filling out the online form
questions.answer: By filling out the online form
questions.explanation: 'To apply, fill out the online form on our website.' 전화는 질문이 있을 때 한다.

questions.q: What is the last day to apply?
questions.explanation: 'by October 31' → 10월 31일까지 신청해야 한다.

questions.q: When should you call 053-987-6543?
choices: When you find a lost cat
When you want to buy a dog
questions.explanation: 'If you have any questions, please call 053-987-6543.'

questions.q: What kind of clothes should volunteers wear?
questions.explanation: 'Please wear comfortable clothes. Your clothes may get dirty!'

questions.q: Which is NOT true about the notice?
choices: Volunteers can come on weekday afternoons.
The form is on the website.
questions.answer: Volunteers can come on weekday afternoons.
questions.explanation: 봉사는 토·일요일 오전 10시~오후 1시에만 한다.

questions.q: Sora is 16, and Jiho is 13. Who can volunteer without a parent?
questions.explanation: 14세 이상만 봉사할 수 있고, 16세 미만은 보호자가 필요하다. 16세 소라는 혼자 가능, 13세 지호는 봉사할 수 없다.

items: Walk dogs and play with cats for three hours.

Get a volunteer hours certificate.

Come to the shelter on a Saturday at 10:00 a.m.
answer: Fill out the online form by October 31.

academy.tagged_body:
Volunteers Wanted: Happy Tails Animal Shelter

Do you love animals? Do you want to {{v:make a difference}} in your community? Happy Tails Animal Shelter is looking for student {{v:volunteers}}!

Our {{v:shelter}} takes care of about 60 dogs and 25 cats {{g:that have been|주격 관계대명사 that + 현재완료 수동태(have been p.p.)}} {{v:abandoned}} or lost. We need your help to {{t:give them a better life}} {{g:while they wait for|while + 주어 + 동사: ~하는 동안}} new families.

Volunteer Activities
- {{g:Walking dogs|동명사(-ing): ~하기 (활동 나열)}}
- Cleaning {{v:cages}} and feeding bowls
- Playing with cats
- Taking photos of animals for our {{v:adoption}} website

Requirements
- Students {{v:aged}} 14 or older
- Students under 16 must come with a parent or {{v:guardian}}.
- Volunteers must {{v:attend}} a one-hour training {{v:session}} {{g:before starting|전치사 before + 동명사: ~하기 전에}}.

Schedule
- Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.
- Volunteers {{g:should come|should + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 (권고)}} {{v:at least}} twice a month.

Volunteers will receive {{v:official}} volunteer hours {{v:certificates}} (3 hours per visit).

{{g:To apply|to부정사 부사적 용법(목적): ~하기 위해}}, {{v:fill out}} the online form on our website by October 31. If you have any questions, please call 053-987-6543.

Note: Please wear {{v:comfortable}} clothes {{g:that you don't mind getting dirty|목적격 관계대명사 that / mind + 동명사: ~하는 것을 꺼리다}}!

advanced.tagged_body:
Volunteers Wanted: Happy Tails Animal Shelter

Are you an animal lover? Are you {{v:eager}} to make a {{v:meaningful}} difference in your community? Happy Tails Animal Shelter is currently {{v:seeking}} student volunteers!

Our shelter provides care for {{v:approximately}} 60 dogs and 25 cats {{g:that have been abandoned by their owners or separated from their families|관계대명사 that + 현재완료 수동태 have been p.p. (abandoned / separated 병렬)}}. We need your support to {{t:improve their lives}} {{g:while they wait to be adopted|while + 주어 + 동사 / to be p.p.: 수동형 to부정사 (입양되기를)}} by new families.

Volunteer Activities
- Taking dogs for walks
- Cleaning cages and feeding bowls
- {{g:Spending time playing with cats|spend + 시간 + -ing: ~하며 시간을 보내다}}
- {{v:Photographing}} animals for our adoption website

Requirements
- {{v:Applicants}} must be at least 14 years old.
- Students under the age of 16 {{g:must be accompanied by|조동사 수동태: must be p.p. (~이 동반되어야 한다)}} a parent or guardian.
- All volunteers {{g:are required to complete|be required to + 동사원형: ~해야 한다}} a one-hour training session before beginning their activities.

Schedule
- Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.
- Volunteers {{g:are expected to visit|be expected to + 동사원형: ~하기로 되어 있다(~해야 한다)}} at least twice a month.

Volunteers {{g:will be awarded|미래 수동태: will be p.p. / award = 수여하다}} official volunteer hours certificates (3 hours per visit).

To apply, complete the online {{v:application}} form on our website by October 31. For further {{v:inquiries}}, please contact us at 053-987-6543.

Note: Please wear comfortable {{v:clothing}} that you {{g:don't mind getting dirty|mind + 동명사: ~하는 것을 꺼리다}}!

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?

essays.q: Summarize in 2-3 English sentences why the shelter needs volunteers and what volunteers will do.
essays.sampleAnswer: The shelter cares for approximately 60 dogs and 25 cats that have been abandoned or separated from their families. It needs volunteers to improve their lives while they wait to be adopted. Volunteers will walk dogs, clean cages and feeding bowls, play with cats, and photograph animals for the adoption website.
essays.rubric: ① 동물 수·처지 ② 봉사자가 필요한 이유 ③ 활동 3개 이상 ④ 영어 2~3문장, 문법 정확성

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'All volunteers are required to complete a one-hour training session'과 'Volunteers are expected to visit at least twice a month'에서 be required to와 be expected to의 뜻을 각각 쓰고, 봉사자가 반드시 해야 하는 일 두 가지를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: be required to는 '~해야 한다(필수)', be expected to는 '~하기로 되어 있다(~할 것이 기대된다)'는 뜻이다. 봉사자는 시작 전 1시간 교육을 반드시 받아야 하고, 한 달에 적어도 두 번 방문해야 한다.
essays.rubric: ① be required to = 의무 ② be expected to = 기대·약속 ③ 1시간 교육 ④ 월 2회 이상 방문

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '16세 미만의 학생들은 부모나 보호자와 동행해야 한다.' <조건> accompany를 수동태로 쓸 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Students under the age of 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
essays.rubric: ① under the age of 16 (또는 under 16) ② must be accompanied ③ by a parent or guardian ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '나는 보호소에서 고양이들과 놀면서 두 시간을 보냈다.' <조건> spend + 시간 + -ing 구문을 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: I spent two hours playing with cats at the shelter.
essays.rubric: ① spent(과거형) ② two hours ③ playing with cats ④ at the shelter

essays.q: You are 15 years old and want to start volunteering at the shelter. Write in English what you need to do before and during your first visit, in time order (at least three steps).
essays.sampleAnswer: First, I will complete the online application form on the website by October 31. Next, I will complete a one-hour training session. Then, on my first Saturday, I will come to the shelter at 10:00 a.m. with my mother because I am under 16. Finally, I will wear comfortable clothing that I don't mind getting dirty.

wordbook.sentence: Are you eager to make a meaningful difference in your community?
Are you eager to make a meaningful difference in your community?
Happy Tails Animal Shelter is currently seeking student volunteers!
Our shelter provides care for approximately 60 dogs and 25 cats that have been abandoned by their owners or separated from their families.
- Photographing animals for our adoption website
- Applicants must be at least 14 years old.
To apply, complete the online application form on our website by October 31.
For further inquiries, please contact us at 053-987-6543.
Note: Please wear comfortable clothing that you don't mind getting dirty!

prestudy.tagged_body:
Volunteers Wanted: Happy Tails Animal Shelter

Are you {{v:passionate about}} animals? Do you {{v:aspire to}} make a {{v:tangible}} difference in your local community? Happy Tails Animal Shelter is currently recruiting {{v:dedicated}} student volunteers!

Our {{v:facility}} {{v:houses}} approximately 60 dogs and 25 cats, {{g:all of which have been abandoned or have gone astray|수량 표현 + of which (계속적 용법 관계대명사) / 현재완료 수동태 · go astray = 길을 잃다}}. We are seeking your assistance in {{t:enhancing their well-being}} {{g:while they await adoption|while + 주어 + 동사 / await = wait for (전치사 없이 목적어)}} into permanent homes.

Volunteer Responsibilities
- Exercising dogs on regular walks
- {{v:Sanitizing}} cages and feeding bowls
- {{v:Socializing}} with cats through play
- Photographing animals {{g:to be featured on|수동형 to부정사: to be p.p. (게시되도록)}} our adoption website

{{v:Eligibility}}
- Applicants must be aged 14 or above.
- Those under 16 must be {{v:accompanied by}} a parent or legal guardian.
- {{g:Prior to commencing|prior to + 동명사: ~하기 전에 (to는 전치사)}} any activities, all volunteers are required to attend a {{v:mandatory}} one-hour {{v:orientation}} session.

Schedule
- Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.
- Volunteers {{g:are expected to commit to a minimum of two visits|be expected to + 동사원형 / commit to + 명사: ~에 전념하다(to는 전치사)}} per month.

{{g:Upon completion of each visit|upon + 명사: ~하자마자, ~할 때}}, volunteers will be {{v:issued}} official certificates recognizing three hours of volunteer service.

To apply, submit the online application form on our website {{v:no later than}} October 31. {{g:Should you have any inquiries|가정법 도치: If you should have → Should you have}}, please contact us at 053-987-6543.

Note: We recommend wearing comfortable {{v:attire}} that you would not mind getting {{v:soiled}}!

questions.q: Which best describes the purpose of the notice?
choices: To persuade local families to adopt abandoned pets immediately
To report on the number of animals adopted from the shelter this year
To promote a paid orientation program for new pet owners
To recruit student volunteers and inform them of their responsibilities, eligibility, and schedule
To request donations for building a new animal facility
questions.answer: To recruit student volunteers and inform them of their responsibilities, eligibility, and schedule
questions.explanation: 학생 자원봉사자를 모집하며 담당 업무·자격·일정·신청 방법을 알리는 글이다.

questions.q: In the notice, 'tangible' in "a tangible difference" is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: tangible = 실질적인, 눈에 보이는(real).

questions.q: What does 'houses' mean in "Our facility houses approximately 60 dogs and 25 cats"?
choices: Provides a place to live for
questions.answer: Provides a place to live for
questions.explanation: house가 동사로 쓰여 '수용하다, 거처를 제공하다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: The phrase "have gone astray" in the notice is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: go astray = 길을 잃다, 행방불명이 되다.

questions.q: In "while they await adoption," 'await' can be replaced with ____.
questions.explanation: await는 타동사로 wait for와 같은 뜻이다(await 뒤에 for를 쓰지 않는다).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed among the Volunteer Responsibilities?
questions.explanation: 털 손질·목욕은 업무 목록에 없다.

questions.q: In "Sanitizing cages and feeding bowls," 'Sanitizing' is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: sanitize = 소독하다, 위생 처리하다.

questions.q: In the notice, 'mandatory' is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: mandatory = 의무적인, 필수의(required).

questions.q: According to the notice, what must all volunteers do prior to commencing any activities?
choices: Adopt at least one animal from the facility
Attend a mandatory one-hour orientation session
Submit a recommendation from a teacher
Visit the facility on two weekdays
Pay a fee for their volunteer certificates
questions.answer: Attend a mandatory one-hour orientation session
questions.explanation: 'Prior to commencing any activities, all volunteers are required to attend a mandatory one-hour orientation session.'

questions.q: Based on the Eligibility section, which applicant may volunteer without being accompanied by an adult?
questions.explanation: 14세 이상이어야 하고, 16세 미만은 부모나 법적 보호자와 동반해야 한다. 17세만 혼자 가능하다.

choices: Minho, who comes once at the start of each month
Hana, who comes on weekday evenings
Tom, who comes once every two months
Jisu, who comes every other Saturday, about twice a month
Yuna, who comes only during summer vacation
questions.answer: Jisu, who comes every other Saturday, about twice a month
questions.explanation: 'commit to a minimum of two visits per month' — 한 달에 최소 두 번 와야 한다.

questions.q: A volunteer visits the shelter three times a month for three months. How many hours of volunteer service will be recognized in total?
questions.explanation: 3회 × 3개월 = 9회, 9회 × 3시간 = 27시간.

questions.q: What does "no later than October 31" mean in the notice?
questions.explanation: no later than = 늦어도 ~까지.

questions.q: Which has the same meaning as "Should you have any inquiries, please contact us"?
choices: You should have some inquiries before contacting us.
If you have any inquiries, please contact us.
Because you have inquiries, you must contact us.
Although you have inquiries, please contact us.
Unless you have inquiries, please contact us.
questions.answer: If you have any inquiries, please contact us.
questions.explanation: 가정법 도치: If you should have ~ → Should you have ~. '문의 사항이 있으시면'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: In "60 dogs and 25 cats, all of which have been abandoned or have gone astray," what does 'which' refer to?
questions.explanation: 'all of which'의 which는 앞의 60 dogs and 25 cats를 가리킨다(계속적 용법).

questions.q: In "comfortable attire that you would not mind getting soiled," 'soiled' is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: soiled = 더러워진(dirty).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT true according to the notice?
choices: The facility cares for approximately 85 animals in total.
Applicants must apply through an online form.
Each visit is recognized as three hours of service.
Volunteer work takes place on weekend mornings.
The orientation session is optional for applicants aged 16 or above.
questions.answer: The orientation session is optional for applicants aged 16 or above.
questions.explanation: 오리엔테이션은 모든 봉사자에게 의무(mandatory)이다.

questions.q: Why is 'commencing' used in "Prior to commencing any activities"?
choices: Because 'to' in 'prior to' is a preposition, so a gerund follows it
Because 'prior' is a verb that takes an -ing object
Because it is a present participle modifying 'activities'
Because the sentence is in the progressive tense
Because a to-infinitive cannot be used in formal writing
questions.answer: Because 'to' in 'prior to' is a preposition, so a gerund follows it
questions.explanation: prior to의 to는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사가 온다 (look forward to -ing와 같은 원리).

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '어떤 활동이든 시작하기 전에, 모든 봉사자들은 오리엔테이션에 참석해야 한다.' <조건> prior to와 be required to를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Prior to commencing any activities, all volunteers are required to attend an orientation session.
essays.rubric: ① Prior to + 동명사(commencing/starting) ② are required to attend ③ orientation (session) ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '문의 사항이 있으시면 저희에게 연락해 주세요.' <조건> if를 쓰지 말고 Should로 시작하는 도치 구문을 쓸 것

essays.q: Some people say that giving volunteer hours certificates makes students volunteer for the wrong reasons. Do you agree? Write your opinion in English with two reasons.
essays.sampleAnswer: I partly disagree. First, certificates can motivate students to try volunteering for the first time, and many of them discover that they truly enjoy helping animals. Second, the shelter requires volunteers to visit at least twice a month, so only students who really care will continue. However, schools should also teach students the real meaning of volunteering.
essays.rubric: ① 입장 명확 ② 근거 2개 ③ 연결어(First, Second, However 등) ④ 영어 문장의 정확성
